Sample.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/4] It was hypothesised that the active treatment condition would produce a significant change in depressive symptoms in the treatment group in contrast to a waiting list control condition and that these results would still be apparent at a 4-month follow-up (= Study 1). Furthermore, the study brings the results of the one-year follow-up of all children treated (= Study 2).
